newsitem.title: USA: BF Goodrich renews shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: BF Goodrich renews shareholder rights plan.

text.p: BFGoodrich Co said Monday it declared a dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right on each outstanding share of common stock.
The company said the rights will replace, and are essentially similar to, its current shareholder rights plan, which was adopted in 1987 and to expire on August 2.

The rights will be exercisable only if a person or group acquires 20 percent or more of BFGoodrich's common stock, or announces a tender offer that would result in ownership of 20 percent or more of the common.
The rights will not prevent a takeover, said the company, but should encourage anyone seeking to acquire the company to negotiate with the board prior to attempting a takeover.
The dividend distribution will be made on August 2, payable to shareholders of record on that date.
